policy: common-sense validators only; no taste policing; no unregistered validator in release pipeline

validators.purpose: Prevent broken GitHub Actions YAML and unsafe workflow drift.
Ensure cumulative master-plan deliverables exist and route families match the lock.
Ensure clean URL canonical policy and prevent clean-to-html redirect loops.
Ensure homepage CTAs route beginning, middle, and end to WPP.
Ensure insights are published deterministically with no active draft queue leakage.
Ensure every programmatic page is built from governed atoms.
Ensure page families have route, atom, schema, CTA, and noindex rules.
Prevent unadmitted programmatic routes and duplicate query-target releases.
Ensure public atlas contains the 6-month query universe.

Refuse to publish a query atlas entry that carries no demand evidence in a named unit. Distinct from `query-atlas`, which validates the public HTML atlas built from data/query_atlas/query_universe.json.

Enforce the demand-unit contract: no row may carry the ambiguous `volume` key, a GSC row may not claim a search_volume without keyword-tool provenance, demand_basis must agree with the populated fields, rank_score must be banded, and no source file may read the removed field off a query row.
Ensure canonical autonomous release contracts and registries exist.
Ensure collector→normalizer→score→release→content proof artifacts exist.
Ensure $0 mode forbids paid providers by default.
Prevent unsafe/guaranteed SEO claims.
Validate truthful static admin and allowlisted operations.
Ensure no published page renders external-agent build directives (FILEPATH:/CURRENT:/MISSING:/EDIT:, citation-ready update text) as reader-facing copy.

Hard-fail when a workflow GitHub reports as active has produced no run inside its own declared cron window, or exists on GitHub with no file and no recorded retirement. Deleting a workflow file leaves the workflow active and frozen on its last result: auto_publish_insights.yml was removed 2026-06-25 and sat red-but-unread for 71 days because a lane that never runs never goes red. Also fails the zero-job YAML parse error and the unindented heredoc terminator that caused it.

Every published HTML page (the real assembled .pages-output tree) keeps email addresses inside <!--email_off--> markers and carries no /cdn-cgi/l/email-protection link, so Cloudflare Email Obfuscation never turns a contact link into a JS-only 404 (16 Oct 2026 audit: every footer on virtualagency-os.com). Fails on zero pages or zero addresses governed.

Every West Peek Organization and founder Person node on every public page states exactly the sameAs (and org description, name, logo) declared in data/entity/entity.json; no sameAs on this site's own host; entity.mjs agrees with entity.json. Zero Organization nodes is a failure.
Every sitemap URL is linked from at least one page of the ASSEMBLED site, so a link that lives only in pre-finish markup cannot ship an orphan.

Every published page's logo, header menu and footer reach westpeekproductions.com (the one main door) and every link labelled with a web address goes to that address (7 Nov 2026: the logo stayed on this site and About's westpeekproductions.com links opened the inquiry form).

repair_policy: repair_command is only declared where the repair targets the same defect the validator detects. Adding one so a failure disappears is forbidden; an unrepairable failure must stay unrepairable and be reported by name.
